en.summary: Informatics Engineering graduate from Universitas Islam Syekh Yusuf (final GPA 3.46/4.00, graduation 27 October 2026), looking for a Web Developer or Data Analyst role. During an internship in the Automation department of PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Balaraja, combined pellet machine and boiler data from the PLC, operator Excel logs and the plant database, and used HDBSCAN clustering to find optimal machine parameters. The recommended parameters were put on a one-week trial. Hard-working, punctual and eager to learn.

bullets: Collected and combined pellet machine and boiler data from three sources: the PLC, operator Excel logs and the plant database.
Applied HDBSCAN (Hierarchical Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) to group operating conditions and determine optimal machine parameters.
The recommended parameters were put on a one-week trial.
